parsed_entries.requirement: Significant data fiduciaries must define and use terms consistently with definitions provided in other statutes.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify that terms like 'advertisement', 'allied healthcare professional', 'clinical establishment', 'healthcare professional', 'health services', and 'mental health establishment' are defined in accordance with their statutory definitions.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to all significant data fiduciaries.
parsed_entries.notes: These definitions are critical for ensuring compliance with other relevant laws and regulations.

parsed_entries.requirement: Significant data fiduciaries must ensure that their members are compensated in accordance with specified salary terms.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify that non-Chairperson members receive a consolidated salary of rupees four lakh per month without house and car facilities.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to all significant data fiduciaries with non-Chairperson members.
parsed_entries.notes: This clause outlines specific compensation terms for members of the Board.

parsed_entries.requirement: Significant data fiduciaries must apply the same terms and conditions for provident fund contributions as those applicable to other officers and employees of the Board.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify that the provident fund terms and conditions for members are consistent with those applicable to other officers and employees of the Board.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to all significant data fiduciaries with members subject to provident fund contributions.
parsed_entries.notes: This ensures uniformity in financial obligations for all members.
